nodes.description: Public Deployment struct holding cause, causeWallet, splits, owner, ownerWallet, ownerSecret, valuePerEntry and all phase timestamps
mapping(address => Participant) storing each participant's committed message and entry count
Private Fund[] array of cumulative-entry checkpoints used by the selection binary search
Private State struct tracking cause/owner messages, withdrawal flags, cancelled flag, participants, entries and reveal block data
Constructor: validates all deployment parameters and writes the Deployment struct, using now as deploy time
View function returning the current fundraiser state fields
View function computing the caller's claimable balance based on role split or cancellation refund
Cause-only function that seeds the cause secret under the participationPhase modifier
Payable function registering a new participant and forwarding to _raise
Private function converting msg.value into entries, appending a Fund and immediately refunding excess wei
Payable fallback that lets existing participants buy additional entries through _raise
Cause-only function revealing the cause message during the recap phase and storing the reveal block number
Private view helper verifying a message against a secret via keccak256(_message, msg.sender)
Owner-only function that fixes the reveal blockhash, derives entropy and selects the winning participant
Private binary search over the funds array mapping an entry index to a participant address
Cancels the fundraiser, open to the community only between expireTime and destructTime
Pays out the caller's balance after setting the appropriate withdrawn flag or zeroing refunded entries
Owner-only selfdestruct available only after destructTime
Owner-only ERC20 rescue that transfers the trapped token balance to deployment._owner
Caller-controlled address used for role checks, participant indexing and payment destinations
now/block.timestamp used by all phase modifiers and by cancel() to gate time windows
msg.sender.transfer(_refund) inside _raise: external ether send to an attacker-chosen address
_wallet.transfer(_balance) inside withdraw: external ether send that closes the payout path
selfdestruct(msg.sender) inside destroy: irreversible destruction of the contract
_state._entries * deployment._valuePerEntry * _split / 1000 multiplication in balance() without SafeMath
uint256(_randomNumber) % _state._entries modulo used for participant selection in end()
block.blockhash(_state._revealBlockNumber) used as a randomness source in end()
_secret == keccak256(_message, msg.sender) commitment check in _decode, address-bound and replayable
_erc20.transfer(deployment._owner, _balance) external call in recover to an arbitrary token contract
_participant._entries += _entries and _state._entries += _entries unchecked addition in Solidity 0.4.19
Constructor parameter _cause: cause address stored in Deployment
Constructor parameter _causeSplit: cause share out of 1000
Constructor parameter _ownerSecret: commitment used later by end()
Constructor parameter _valuePerEntry: wei price of a single entry
Constructor parameter _entropy: number of selection loop iterations
participate() parameter _message: participant commitment message
begin() parameter _secret: cause secret seeded into state
reveal() parameter _message: cause message validated against the cause secret
end() parameter _message: owner message validated against the owner secret and used as entropy seed
_findParticipant() parameter _entry: entry index to resolve to an address
recover() parameter _token: ERC20 token address whose balance is rescued
_decode() parameter _secret: commitment compared against the hashed message
_decode() parameter _message: message hashed together with msg.sender
Participant storage pointer in participate()/fallback()/withdraw() referring to participants[msg.sender]
Local _entries returned by _raise and emitted in events
Local _refund returned by _raise, sent back to msg.sender
Local _wallet in withdraw() holding the final payout destination
Local _balance in withdraw() holding the value returned by balance()
Local _randomNumber in end() accumulating keccak256 entropy each loop iteration
Local _split in balance() holding the caller's share out of 1000
Local _erc20 in recover() typed as ERC20 at the caller-supplied token address

edges.reason: balance() branches on msg.sender to decide which role split or refund the caller may claim
participate() indexes participants[msg.sender] to register the caller
_raise() records msg.sender as the fund participant and as the refund recipient
fallback() looks up the existing participants[msg.sender] record before raising
withdraw() selects the payout branch from msg.sender and transfers ether to it
cancel() compares msg.sender to owner and cause to decide whether the community time window is required
_decode() binds the commitment to the caller because msg.sender is part of keccak256(_message, msg.sender)
constructor requires _endTime > now and persists now as deployment._deployTime
participationPhase modifier gates begin() on now < deployment._endTime
participationPhase modifier gates participate() on now < deployment._endTime
participationPhase modifier gates the payable fallback on now < deployment._endTime
recapPhase modifier gates reveal() on now between _endTime and _expireTime
recapPhase modifier gates end() on now between _endTime and _expireTime
cancel() opens community cancellation only when now is between _expireTime and _destructTime
destructionPhase modifier gates destroy() on now >= deployment._destructTime
participate() calls _raise() to convert msg.value into entries
fallback() forwards additional ether to _raise()
withdraw() starts by calling balance() to compute the payable amount
reveal() validates the cause message through _decode()
end() validates the owner message through _decode()
end() calls _findParticipant() for every entropy iteration to select a winner
constructor writes the Deployment struct into the deployment state variable
_raise() executes msg.sender.transfer(_refund), an external call to an untrusted address
withdraw() executes _wallet.transfer(_balance) after mutating withdrawal state
destroy() executes selfdestruct(msg.sender) unconditionally after the time gate
balance() multiplies _state._entries, _valuePerEntry and _split before dividing by 1000
end() reduces the keccak-derived random number modulo _state._entries, which can divide by zero if entries is 0
end() derives its entropy from block.blockhash, which miners can influence
_decode() performs the secret/message equality check that guards reveal() and end()
recover() calls transfer on an arbitrary caller-supplied ERC20 contract
_raise() increases participant and global entry counters without SafeMath, allowing overflow
balance() reads deployment splits, wallets and valuePerEntry to compute the payout
_raise() reads deployment._valuePerEntry to convert wei into entries and refunds
end() reads deployment._ownerSecret and deployment._entropy to validate and loop
_decode() is only meaningful because deployment roles gate who may call reveal() and end()
_raise() mutates the stored Participant entry count for msg.sender
balance() reads participants[msg.sender]._entries for the cancellation refund path
withdraw() zeroes participants[msg.sender]._entries to prevent double refunds
_raise() pushes a new cumulative-entry Fund onto the funds array
_findParticipant() binary searches the funds array to resolve an entry index
end() writes _state._ownerMessage, _state._revealBlockHash and _state._participant
begin() writes _state._causeSecret to open the fundraiser
withdraw() flips the withdrawn flags inside _state before paying out ether
cancel() sets _state._cancelled to true, changing all later phase behaviour
the refund transfer inside _raise can re-enter the payable fallback and buy more entries
the withdraw payout can re-enter the payable fallback before the caller's state is fully settled
the withdraw payout re-enters withdraw() and re-evaluates balance() for the same caller
